title: MZ Cinematic camera scroll/move/control plugin? (read further)

posts.author: RPGMakerUser4001
posts.body:
Is there a camera control plugin that will allow me to move the camera to follow/scroll to an event or location on the map just like Galv's Cam Control that DOESN'T offset the camera slightly below and sometimes slightly left/right of the player? I know it sounds minor but this is a big problem if you have tall sprites as the player looks too high up on the screen and is not centered.
Someone has brought this up to Galv in the comments of his plugin on his website but he's not updating the plugin anymore, so are there any other plugins just like his without this issue? I can't find any. I've tried Tyruswoo_CameraControl but it doesn't allow you to scroll the map to a location, it only instantly switches to a location.

posts.author: RPGMakerUser4001
posts.body: Thank you for the suggestion but I'd rather not use obfuscated plugins as they can mess things up and leave no way to edit the code to fix things.

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
I have this one, but it is paid:
Hakuen Studio Camera Manager for RPG Maker MZ by Hakuen Studio
Enhances the camera system of RPG Maker MZ, including easing effects for scrolling!
hakuenstudio.itch.io
You can take a look at the help file link to better know if it suits your needs.
Need my core plugin somewhere above it:
Hakuen Studio Eli Book RPG Maker MZ by Hakuen Studio
Essential plugin for all Eli plugins in RPG Maker MV/MZ!
hakuenstudio.itch.io
